blogPosts.title: Best Native Plants for Landscaping in Templestowe & Mont Albert
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore the top native plants suited to Melbourne's eastern suburbs for low-maintenance, beautiful gardens that thrive in local conditions.

Native gardens also support local biodiversity, attracting birds and insects that enhance ecosystem health. Incorporating layers of vegetation—from ground covers to shrubs like Westringia—creates a structured, visually appealing garden. Water efficiency is a major advantage of native landscaping in Mont Albert and Templestowe. Mulching with organic materials further conserves water and improves soil health. Seasonal considerations are vital for maintaining native gardens in Melbourne's east. In Mont Albert, pruning should be done after flowering to encourage healthy growth. Pest management is simplified as natives often repel insects naturally, but occasional monitoring for aphids or scale is recommended. For Templestowe residents, incorporating edible natives like Lemon Myrtle adds functional value. Ecohaven's maintenance plans include seasonal check-ups to keep native gardens thriving. Always consult local nursery experts for region-specific advice, as conditions can vary even within suburbs.

In conclusion, native plants offer a sustainable, low-maintenance solution for landscaping in Templestowe and Mont Albert.
